data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Google Cloud FDE Field-Readiness & Project Grading Rubric (Mandatory Governance Standard)
data.description: Enforceable grading rubric and competency standard for all Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) and Antigravity-driven Agentic AI projects, spanning Presentation & Advisory Rigor (Part A) and Engineering & Implementation Excellence (Part B) across 30+ sub-competencies and prevailing customer case studies.
